title: JAILBREAK ANTIDOTE: RUNTIME SAFETY-UTILITY BALANCE VIA SPARSE REPRESENTATION ADJUSTMENT IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on Large Language Model safety and alignment, specifically defending against jailbreak attacks. It evaluates its method using standard safety benchmarks (JailbreakBench) and an AI judge that explicitly rates responses based on whether they violate 'ethical, legal, or safety guidelines.' Furthermore, it includes qualitative test cases involving sensitive social and moral topics such as racism and biracial marriage to assess model refusal behavior.
